title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Location: Kochi**  

**Permanent, full\-time**

**About Us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400; employees and 70,000; customers across 100; countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.


**Build Your Career with Cyncly in Kochi**

Kochi is Cyncly’s newest hub, opening doors to exciting career opportunities across diverse functions. Here, you’ll collaborate with global experts, engage in innovative projects, and grow in a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and continuous learning. With access to top mentors, excellent learning resources, and a flexible and autonomous working environment, you’ll have everything you need to thrive.


Make it amazing—take your career to the next level with Cyncly in Kochi!


**About the role:**

You will work with cutting\-edge technology to architect and design innovative software solutions. This role involves collaborating on requirement gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment of projects within our suite of solutions. You will contribute to transforming how customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed, and made—serving industries such as Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring worldwide.
 

**Accounting \& Domain Expertise**

* Serve as the subject matter expert for accounting workflows and financial processes.
* Interpret and implement accounting requirements related to:
	+ General Ledger (GL)
	+ Accounts Payable (AP)
	+ Accounts Receivable (AR)
	+ Fixed Assets
	+ Revenue Recognition
	+ Financial Consolidations
	+ Month\-End and Year\-End Close
	+ Work In Progress Accounting
* Ensure software solutions align with US GAAP principles and industry\-standard accounting practices.
* Collaborate with accountants, business analysts, and product managers to define accounting requirements.
* Review financial calculations, reports, and accounting logic embedded within applications.
* Work in Progress (WIP) accounting, including how WIP relates to job costing, revenue recognition, costs, billing, and financial reporting.

**Software Development**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications focused on accounting and finance domains.
* Translate accounting and taxation requirements into technical specifications and software features.
* Develop scalable APIs, services, and business logic supporting financial transactions and reporting.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to software engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex accounting\-related system issues and propose effective solutions.
* Contribute to system architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization.

**Product \& Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with product teams to define feature roadmaps for accounting software products.
* Assist QA teams in creating accounting\-focused test scenarios and validation frameworks.
* Support customer implementations and provide guidance on accounting configurations when needed.
* Mentor junior developers on accounting concepts and domain\-specific business rules.
**Essential Skills – apply only if you possess** :


**Accounting**

* Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ US GAAP
	+ Financial Statements
	+ Revenue Recognition
	+ Financial Reporting
	+ General Ledger Accounting
	+ Month\-End Close Processes
	+ Work In Progress Accounting
* Experience working in accounting, auditing, tax, or financial systems environments.

**Technical**

* 8\-10 years of software development experience.
* Strong programming skills in the following:
	+ C\#
	+ .NET
	+ PHP
* Experience developing web applications and APIs.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar databases
	+ Object\-Oriented Design
	+ Software Design Patterns
	+ REST APIs
	+ Cloud Technologies (Azure/AWS)
	+ Client side scripting (Javascript, HTML, Angular JS)
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
**Our ideal candidate profile:**

* Experience developing accounting, tax, payroll, or financial management software.
* A desirable business process or ERP knowledge area
* Knowledge of US Federal and State Taxation.
* Experience integrating with third\-party accounting platforms
* Exposure to AI\-assisted development tools and automation technologies.
* Understanding of financial data analytics and reporting platforms.
* Knowledge on ERP systems would be advantageous (NetSuite, Sage, Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle Financials)

**Working for us:**

We are a dynamic and innovative company that still holds onto our founding ethos of collaboration, openness, and commitment to excellence. We have big ambitions, and we are moving fast to reach them through our biggest asset – our people.


You can expect to work in a supportive and nurturing environment, with experts in their fields who strive for quality and excellence without compromising others. We also believe in a flexible and autonomous working environment, focused on the continual growth of our employees.


Our teams recognize that all people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of the position. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and brilliance, so we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our roles.


Come and join an international and motivated team in a growing technology company.

title: Jr. Software Engineer (.Net)
description:
**Job Summary**

Job Title: Junior Associate – Software Engineering (Core)  
Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, India  
Job Type: Full\-time, Permanent  
Experience: 1\-3 year preferred  
Department: Engineering  
Reporting To: Vice President – Engineering  
Preference: Immediate joiners preferred

**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a London\-headquartered global SaaS and software product company with strong engineering operations in Kochi, India. Eloit is on a mission of unlocking potential through graceful innovation.

Our platforms include Edisapp School ERP and LMS, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and other growing technology products serving schools, institutions, and faith communities across the globe.

**The Role**

We are hiring a skilled **Junior .NET Developer** to support the development and maintenance of our SaaS and mobile products. You will work on building, improving, and supporting applications across the stack, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and contribute to delivering reliable and scalable solutions. This role is ideal for a developer with solid technical skills, a problem\-solving mindset, and a strong willingness to learn and grow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Feature Implementation:** Develop and maintain backend modules using **.NET Core / .NET 8** based on detailed technical specifications.
* **Logic Execution:** Translate business requirements into "minute logic" within the code, ensuring all edge cases are handled before the front\-end integration.
* **API Maintenance:** Support and update RESTful APIs, ensuring they remain performant and secure for mobile and web clients.
* **Database Tasks:** Write clean, optimized SQL queries and assist in maintaining database integrity in MS SQL Server.
* **Code Quality:** Follow "European Professional" coding standards—writing clean, sharp, and modular code that is easy to peer\-review.

**Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or Engineering.
* **Experience:** 0–1 year experience in C\# and 0–2 years experience in .NET development.
* **Service\-Based Background:** Experience working in a service\-oriented company where meeting project deadlines and following client specs is key.
* **Core Tech:** Good understanding of C\#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework.
* **Database Basics:** Practical knowledge of SQL Server (Joins, Indexes, Stored Procedures).
* **Tools:** Basic proficiency with **Git** (Branching, Merging, Pull Requests).
* **Mindset:** A logical approach to problem\-solving and a strong eagerness to learn modern architectures like .NET 10\.

**Preferred Qualities**

* Mature, disciplined, and values\-driven leadership style.
* Strong sense of responsibility for people, product quality, client success, and long\-term technical excellence.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor, guide, and build high\-performing QA teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-growing SaaS product environment with multiple products, priorities, and release cycles.
* Commitment to Eloit’s mission of building meaningful technology through graceful innovation.

**Tech Stack**  
C\# \* .NET Core / ASP.NET Core \* JavaScript / TypeScript \* HTML5 \* CSS3 / Bootstrap \* REST APIs \* Entity Framework Core \* SQL Server / Azure SQL \* Git \* Azure App Services \* JSON \* IIS

**Compensation \& Benefits** 

* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you won't just be doing a job \- you'll be part of a mission. We build technology that impacts thousands of schools, students, and faith communities across the globe, and every person on our team plays a real role in that story.

We are a decade\-old, London\-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India \- building world\-class platforms trusted by 700\+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we invest in the people who make it happen.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates may send their resume and cover letter explaining their suitability for this role to:

Email: jobs@eloit.com

Subject Line: Junior Associate – Software Engineering

Website: www.eloit.com

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* What is your Last Drawn CTC?
* What is the Notice Period?

* total work: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
About the Role

Elkanio is hiring a **Senior Python Developer** to join an established engineering team working on a prestigious **B2C travel experience booking platform**. The product is live, has real users, and is scaling — we're expanding the team to accelerate the roadmap, strengthen delivery, and evolve the platform further.

You'll be plugging into an existing codebase and a working engineering team, contributing to new features, performance improvements, architectural enhancements, and platform evolution. This is a role for someone who's comfortable navigating mature systems, picking up context quickly, making sound technical decisions, and adding value from week one.

Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to take ownership of technical solutions, participate in system and architectural design, identify areas for improvement, and help the team build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.

What You'll Do

* Build new features and enhance existing ones across the stack, with **Python/Django** as the primary backend technology.
* Work within an established production codebase: understand it carefully, respect existing patterns, and improve it thoughtfully.
* Design and extend **scalable RESTful APIs** powering booking flows, search, payments, user journeys, and other core platform capabilities.
* Translate business and product requirements into robust technical solutions, defining components, APIs, data flows, and integration approaches.
* Participate actively in **system design and architectural decisions**, considering scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, and delivery timelines.
* Own technical solutions for assigned modules or business domains from **requirement analysis and design through implementation, deployment, and production support**.
* Review existing architecture and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and improve system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Design solutions for high\-volume search, booking, payment, and transaction workflows, with appropriate handling of concurrency, failures, retries, and data consistency.
* Design and optimize database models, queries, indexing strategies, caching approaches, and data\-access patterns to support application performance and scale.
* Integrate and maintain third\-party services including **payment gateways, mapping services, communication platforms, and travel\-domain APIs**.
* Design resilient third\-party integrations with appropriate timeout handling, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Identify and address **performance bottlenecks, technical debt, architectural limitations, and scalability concerns** as the platform grows.
* Collaborate with the client's product, design, and engineering teams on planning, technical discussions, design reviews, and releases.
* Participate in code reviews and technical design reviews, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to engineering standards.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and contribute to improving team engineering practices.
* Debug and resolve production issues with ownership and urgency, while identifying and addressing underlying technical causes.
* Communicate technical approaches, trade\-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

* **4–8 years of hands\-on software development experience**, with significant experience building production\-grade backend applications.
* Strong backend expertise in **Python**, with solid hands\-on experience in frameworks such as **Django**.
* Strong understanding of **software architecture and system design**, with the ability to design scalable backend solutions from business requirements.
* Proven experience designing and implementing **RESTful APIs and backend services** in production environments.
* Strong understanding of architectural and engineering principles such as **SOLID, separation of concerns, modularity, design patterns, and clean, maintainable code**.
* Ability to work effectively with and extend **existing production codebases**, rather than focusing only on greenfield development.
* Ability to make sound technical trade\-offs across **performance, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery timelines**.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and general security best practices.
* Strong experience with relational databases, particularly **PostgreSQL**, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
* Working knowledge of **NoSQL databases such as MongoDB** and an understanding of when different data\-storage approaches are appropriate.
* Experience with caching, background processing, asynchronous workflows, queues, or similar approaches used in scalable applications.
* Experience identifying application and system bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve **performance and scalability**.
* Experience designing and working with third\-party integrations and external APIs.
* Proficiency with **Git** and collaborative software development workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly **AWS**, and containerization technologies such as **Docker**.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, create implementation approaches, and communicate **technical designs and architectural decisions** clearly.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a client\-facing setup.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to mentor developers, participate in technical discussions, and provide constructive guidance through design and code reviews.

Senior\-Level Ownership

As a Senior Developer, you'll be expected to go beyond implementation and take ownership of the technical direction of the areas you work on.

* Own technical solutions for assigned modules or business domains.
* Act as a technical point of contact for complex backend, integration, and production issues.
* Evaluate existing implementations and recommend pragmatic architectural improvements.
* Challenge requirements constructively and propose technically sound alternatives where appropriate.
* Balance ideal engineering solutions with practical business and delivery constraints.
* Identify architectural risks and technical debt early and help establish practical remediation plans.
* Mentor other developers on coding practices, design approaches, debugging, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute to defining and maintaining coding standards, design patterns, and engineering practices across the team.

Bonus Points

* Prior experience working on **B2C platforms**, especially in travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-heavy domains.
* Experience contributing to **mature, production\-scale systems** with real users and high availability requirements.
* Experience with **payment gateways and third\-party booking/inventory APIs**.
* Experience with travel\-domain APIs, flight/hotel booking platforms, GDS/NDC, OTA, or other travel technology integrations.
* Experience with distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, message queues, or asynchronous processing.
* Experience with application monitoring, logging, observability, and production performance analysis.
* Experience creating **architecture diagrams, technical design documents, API contracts, or solution designs**.

What We Offer

* Compensation aligned with your experience and the industry standard — we don't underpay good people.
* The opportunity to work on a **marquee B2C travel product with real users and real\-world impact**.
* A collaborative, low\-ego engineering environment where ideas and technical discussions are encouraged.
* Direct exposure to **client stakeholders, product teams, and technical decision\-making**.
* The opportunity to work on challenging problems involving **scale, integrations, performance, payments, and travel technology**.
* Room to grow technically, take ownership of larger areas, and contribute to the evolution of the platform.
* An environment where senior engineers can influence **architecture, engineering practices, and product evolution**, rather than simply implementing assigned tasks.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Python: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
